```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
year = 2025
crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page = rvest::read_html(crash_url)

crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table()

# Cleaning up in four steps: translate into data frame, replace headers with actual titles, date column into date,
# split multiple information within a cell to separate columns

crashdf = crash_tables[[1]]

colnames(crashdf) = crashdf[1, ]
crashdf = crashdf[-1, ]

crashdf = crashdf |>
  dplyr::mutate(Date = lubridate::dmy(Date))

dplyr::glimpse(crashdf)
```

```{r}
page = rvest::read_html("https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1")

length(classes)

base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 400, by = 50)
pages = vector("list", length(starts))
for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i]))
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = Dreadnought,
    value = ??? |> readr::parse_number()
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)   # robots.txt asks for it
}
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)   # 400 rows?

dreadnoughtdf = registry |>
  dplyr::filter(class == "Dreadnought")

sum(dreadnoughtdf$value)
```
